title: SweetSpot Heating and Cooling: Creative Strategist (AI-Native, Direct Response)
description: Headquarters: New York, New York, United States URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/ About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale. About the role We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch. This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend. What you will do • Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research. • Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency. • Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad. • Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad. • Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named. • Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round. • Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows. What we are looking for • Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them. • A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations. • Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses. • AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how. • Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads. • Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed. • Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here. Pay and structure • Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience. • Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads. • Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales. Our hiring process (exactly how it works) • Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow). • Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete. • Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario. • Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more. • Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30. We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

title: Abnormal: AI Security Sales Executive, North Central
description: Headquarters: Remote - USA ABOUT THE ROLE AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market. The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will work alongside the Account Executives who know our customers best: joining land motions, driving AI Security expansion across our 5,000+ customers, and running focused outbound to win net new logos in the largest enterprises. Early on, most of your focus will be expansion. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it. The timing matters. Abnormal is growing quickly, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up regularly in customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. You will have real say in how this category gets sold. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Own AI Security in your region. Carry the AI Security quota and run the sales cycle from first conversation through close. • Drive expansion across our customer base. Lead upsell campaigns into customers who already trust Abnormal, and join land motions where AI Security belongs in the conversation. • Run focused pipeline generation. Build a targeted, strategic outbound motion to open net new logos in the largest enterprises, partnering with the core AE where a relationship exists. Quality over volume. • Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your region, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most. • Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on AI governance, agent security, and cloud security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch. • Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table. • Shape the product and the playbook. Work directly with Product and R&D leadership, including our co-founder and CTO, and feed what you hear in the field back in a fast loop as the suite matures from early availability to GA. • Build AI Security expertise across the sales team, in addition to closing. • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace. WHAT YOU'LL SELL Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability: • AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost. • AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots. • AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions. • AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended. • AI Security Workbench: Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open. For the right person, that means owning a brand-new motion at the center of a fast-growing company, working directly with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR • 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of personal quota attainment and winning new business. • Hands-on experience selling an AI product, with enough technical and product depth to run the sales cycle as the expert and give our product team credible feedback. • A record of selling in security or closely adjacent infrastructure. • Technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers. • A consultative, challenger style, paired with the hunter instincts to run strategic outbound into new logos. • Comfort operating in ambiguity. The suite and the motion for selling it are still evolving, and much of the playbook will be written by whoever takes this role on. • Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints. NICE TO HAVES • Direct experience selling AI security, cloud security, or other emerging security categories. • Experience as an early seller or builder of a new motion: a first sales hire, a founding seller, or a new product line launched inside a larger company. • Experience in an overlay, specialist, or advisory role in cybersecurity or AI, or a record of selling into CISOs and security leaders. • Experience selling early-availability products and shaping design partner deals. Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Base salary range: $157,250 — $185,000 USD A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards. Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please click here . If you would like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/abnormal-ai-security-sales-executive-north-central

title: Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer

title: AI Associate - m/f/d
description:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

About the Role

This is a full-time, 12-month program at our Berlin HQ for people who want to understand AI rather than just use it.

It begins where our product meets the real world: customer support. Many support tickets are a small puzzle about how large language models and cloud software behave in production. Why did the same prompt give two different answers? Why did a long document get cut off? Why is one model fast today and slow tomorrow? Why did an agent call the wrong tool? Why did an API integration time out? You will be the person who works out what is actually going on and explains it clearly.

For most of your first year, the support queue is your home base and your classroom. Few jobs expose you to as many real AI systems, real enterprise environments, and real failure modes, every single day.

The purpose of the year: by month twelve, you should understand our platform and operations deeply, from the chat interface down to the models and infrastructure behind it. A Langdock business team should want to hire you permanently, and you should have found the work that energizes you most.

What You Will Learn to Understand

Customers ask the questions that the rest of the world is still figuring out. To answer them, you will build real intuition for:

  • How LLMs actually behave: tokens and context windows, sampling and non-determinism, hallucinations, prompt sensitivity, system prompts, and why models from different providers react differently to the same input.

  • Agents, tools, and retrieval: how agents plan and call tools, how knowledge bases and document search feed context to a model, and where these chains tend to break.

  • Cloud software in production: APIs, authentication and SSO, rate limits, latency, integrations, multi-tenant enterprise setups, data residency, and access control.

  • Inference and compute: what happens when a request hits a model, why throughput, latency, and cost trade off against each other, and how running our own inference changes what we can offer customers.

  • Daily operational tasks: resolving billing issues, reporting bugs and being the point of for our customers.

You do not need to know all of this on day one. You need to be the kind of person who cannot stop asking why until you do.

How the Year Works

Onboarding: Learn the platform by supporting it. You go through an intensive onboarding into our products, the underlying models, and the support queue. You shadow your first tickets, get to know our systems, and start resolving real customer issues. Expect plenty of experimenting, plenty of questions, and a steep learning curve.

Post-Onboarding: Own the queue and take on sidequests. Alongside the queue, you start picking up work from other teams: tasks below the threshold for a specialist to own but too valuable for your learning to ignore. This includes taking a sales call for a new lead, running a short customer workshop, building customer use cases, writing internal documentation, building internal agents, and further building out our own AI support tooling. As our inference and cloud offering grows, you will increasingly help customers understand and adopt it.

What You Will Do

  • Front-line customer support. Spend most of your day in the queue, handling customer tickets end-to-end across model behavior, API integrations, enterprise compliance, billing, and access control.

  • Investigate what is happening under the hood. Reproduce issues, compare model behavior, read logs and API responses, and separate "the model did something unexpected" from "the system did something wrong." Then give users clear, empathetic, and accurate answers.

  • Explain AI to the people who use it. Help customers understand non-determinism, model limits, context handling, latency, and model choice in plain language, so they can use AI with confidence.

  • Take on cross-team sidequests. Pick up the real work that falls between teams, like a small inbound sales call, a customer workshop, a piece of documentation, or an internal automation. These tasks are small in scope, but you fully own them.

  • Escalate to engineering and product. Flag recurring user friction, document edge cases with clear reproduction steps, and report bugs directly to the engineers building our platform and infrastructure.

  • Improve support with AI. Propose practical improvements to our support workflow and build and test the internal AI tooling that helps resolve routine questions faster.

What Graduation Looks Like

You start on a 12-month fixed-term contract. The program is designed so that strong performance turns into a permanent contract in a business department that suits your strengths: AI Adoption Management, Sales, Partnerships, Marketing, Recruiting, RevOps, Operations, Solutions Engineering, or elsewhere in the Business team.

We are expanding fast in two directions: across the work people do, with chat, agents, meetings, code, and apps; and down the stack, into our own cloud, compute, and inference. Wherever you land, you will bring something rare: a deep, hands-on understanding of how AI and AI infrastructure actually behave for real customers.

We make the decision together based on your performance in the queue, how you handled sidequests, and whether the team you want to join has a role for you. So far, AI Associates have graduated into Account/AI Adoption Management, Sales and Solutions Engineering. We are looking to broaden the program as a gateway into all business functions.

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • You are fascinated by how AI works. You have gone down rabbit holes on why models behave the way they do, and you want a job where that curiosity is the core of the work.

  • You want to understand the stack, not just the surface. Cloud software, APIs, and inference interest you, and you are excited to learn how models are served, scaled, and made fast and reliable.

  • You are genuinely excited about front-line AI support. You take pride in helping customers, write with patience and clarity, and enjoy working through a busy ticket queue.

  • You think in systems and love analysis. You enjoy breaking down tricky technical or operational problems and figuring out what is really happening under the hood.

  • You show high agency and full ownership. You see a ticket through from first message to resolution and dig into root causes so the same issues do not keep coming back.

  • You experiment constantly. You try new models, automations, and tools, and you instinctively look for ways technology can make work easier.

  • You communicate clearly and professionally in English. German is a plus and useful in the queue.

  • You are kind and care about the people around you.

What We Need

  • Availability to start full-time and work 100% on-site at our Berlin office for the full 12 months.

  • A work permit for Germany.

  • Technical or analytical grounding. Studies or hands-on experience in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field, or a track record of building technical projects, is a plus but not a requirement. Curiosity about how AI and cloud systems work is.

The Environment

You will work from our Berlin office at Greifswalder Straße 212, where all of us work together in person, surrounded by people building AI products and infrastructure every day. Lunch and dinner are catered in the office. We look after ourselves, and gym membership and coaching resources are part of the standard package. We value Calm Urgency, Ambitious Execution, and Caring Ownership. The vibe is calm but intense.

Compensation

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.

Next Steps

We move fast, and most hiring processes finish within two weeks. If you want to spend a year truly understanding AI, from the conversation down to the compute, we would love to hear from you.
